jobs.prompt: A 1536x1024 sprite sheet laid out as a strict 2-column by 4-row grid of eight equal cells, read left to right then top to bottom, showing one effect across eight animation frames: 1 anticipation, 2 release, 3 travel, 4 travel, 5 pre-contact, 6 contact peak, 7 reaction, 8 dissipation. Hand-painted storybook game VFX with dark confident outlines and restrained afterglow, matching the rendering, line weight and cell framing of the reference sheet exactly. The effect body only: no characters, no creatures, no scenery, no floor, no UI, no text, no numbers, no frame borders. Every cell sits on the same flat uniform cyan chroma background for keying. Critical: the effect itself must contain no cyan, aqua, turquoise or pale sky-blue anywhere, so it stays clearly separable from the cyan background when the background is keyed out. This comes from a large sleeping guardian animal stirring in its dream, not from an attacker: the motion is soft, heavy and accidental, never sharp or aggressive. The effect is a heavy wooden well bucket tipping over and pouring its water forward to the right. Frame 1 the bucket rocks and begins to tilt, rope slack. Frames 2-4 it tips and a thick rope of water pours out in a slow arc. Frame 6 the water lands at the right in a broad soft splash, rounded rather than sharp. Frames 7-8 the pour thins to drips and the bucket rights itself. Palette: dark oiled wood, iron banding, deep navy water with cream foam.
